semantics.bytes: sealed payloads re-read and checked (length + SHA-256) before scanning; invalid bytes are never masked by signature hits
semantics.identity: identifierType+identifierValue exact tuple; same bytes under different identities are separate records
semantics.matching: all fully-matching signatures; identified iff all hits name one format, ambiguous iff hits name several, unidentified iff no hits
semantics.scope: bitstream identities declared in the given sealed package set only; staging packages never enter
